name: x_upload_media
description: Upload an image so a post can carry it. COSTS MONEY (a billed API call). Takes a path to a file on this machine, up to 5 MB: JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP. Returns { data: { id } } — pass that id to x_post as --media_ids. A post may carry up to 4 images, or 1 animated GIF. Video is not supported: it needs X's four-call chunked upload. The file is read from disk and published, so upload only what the user meant to publish.

media.description: Path to the image on this machine, e.g. './out/hero.png'.
